narration.text: Every record a second opinion needs requested from five providers, at the fee the rule allows, and the late one chased. This is a chore for a patient with a spine problem gathering her own records from five providers before a second opinion in three weeks. Athena works it across 5 portals: Mailnest, Carenook, Clinora, Patientry and Faxline. On the bench, she found 7 of 7 eligible items, worth 342 dollars and 50 cents of the 342 dollars and 50 cents there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 8 traps, and she walked past 8. Among them: Her spouse's complete record, reached by proxy. A dispute of the insurer's copy, which the cost-based limit no longer reaches. She took 3 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 8 hours, so she was about 185 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
